name: find-test-content trigger queries
description: Should trigger when searching an EDS site (local dev, .aem.page or .aem.live) for existing pages that use a specific block or block variant; near misses are creating local test pages or cloning DA content (aem-cli), authoring HTML for DA (da-content), surveying local block folders or the Block Collection (block-inventory / block-collection-and-party), importing an external page (page-import), or running block tests (testing-blocks).

queries.query: Which pages on our site currently use the `cards` block, and which variants do they use? The local dev server is running on port 3000.
I'm about to refactor `blocks/hero/hero.css` and need existing pages on `main--acme--myorg.aem.page` that have the `hero` block so I can test every variant.
Before we remove the `carousel` block, find all published pages on `main--site--org.aem.live` that still contain an instance of `carousel`.
Do any pages on our preview site (`main--marketing--org.aem.page`) use the `columns (dark)` variant? List the URLs.
Scan our indexed pages on `localhost:3000` and tell me how many pages use the `accordion` block and which ones have multiple instances on the same page.
I want to search `main--bigsite--org.aem.page` for pages containing the `tabs` block without hitting 429 rate limits. Run a gentle search and list the matching URLs.
Before I touch `blocks/quote/`, find me a couple of existing pages on the local dev server that already have a `quote` block on them so I have test URLs.
What variants of the `Embed` block are actually used across the pages of `main--docs--org.aem.live`?
We're building a brand-new `pricing-calculator` block that doesn't exist on the site yet. Create a local test HTML page so we can preview it with `aem up`.
Check whether Adobe's Block Collection or Block Party has a reference implementation for a `breadcrumb` or `modal` block we can copy into our repo.
Survey which blocks exist in this repository's `blocks/` folder and in the Block Collection so we know our block palette before importing a page.
Clone the `/drafts` folder from our da.live site into `./content/` so I can edit those pages locally.
The `cards` block is done and we already have `/docs/library/blocks/cards`. Write the unit and Playwright E2E tests for it.
Import https://www.example.com/pricing into our EDS site as a new page.
Write the HTML for a DA page containing a `hero` block and a `section-metadata` block so I can PUT it to `admin.da.live/source`.
